errors.emptyEnvironment: box target environment cannot be empty
errors.zeroTtl: box target ttlSeconds must be a positive integer, got 0
errors.excessiveTtl: box target ttlSeconds exceeds Box's 30-day ceiling: 2592001
errors.malformedPersistedId: Box CLI returned malformed persisted box id: "../foreign"
errors.foreignPersistedKind: handoff rec1 stores an Agent Sandbox identity but its target snapshot is box — state.json tampered or corrupted?

bootstrapScript:
set -eu
if [ "$(uname -m)" != x86_64 ]; then
  echo 'beam: Box requires an x86_64 sandbox' >&2; exit 2
fi
if ! command -v rsync >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'beam: Box needs rsync and curl; no apt-get was found' >&2; exit 2; }
  sudo apt-get update -qq
  sudo apt-get install -y -qq rsync curl ca-certificates coreutils
fi
if ! command -v herdr >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  __beam_herdr="$(mktemp)"
  curl -fsSL -o "$__beam_herdr" 'https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr/releases/download/v0.8.0/herdr-linux-x86_64'
  printf '%s  %s\n' 'b872ea7e40fa2cb17e857ac9b62b1bf26db7b403c622f5d2f3f5b35f6e9acd28' "$__beam_herdr" | sha256sum -c -
  sudo install -m 0755 "$__beam_herdr" /usr/local/bin/herdr
  rm -f "$__beam_herdr"
fi
command -v rsync >/dev/null && command -v herdr >/dev/null
